append.detail: 2026-11-14: (1) the Site-only surface filter is in, dark. The registry marks a Space block that has no Site render `notOnSite` (today link cards and Donate, both Spotlight-only); `blockRendersOnSite` and `siteSurfaceRows` (lib/entity-blocks) drop those ids from a Site's resolved rows, keeping the row shape. The house Home applies it only with EDITOR_CANVAS on, so with the switch off the Site draws exactly what it drew (site-kind.test.ts). (2) the Site picture is wired, not taken: `editorTargetSurfaces` adds `editor-site` (anon, first screen) from PW_SITE_URL, a published Site's own https origin, read by e2e-manual.yml, because a Site renders only on its own host and never under PW_BASE_URL. Still open: the owner sets the PW_SITE_URL repo variable and dispatches e2e-manual with update_baselines; the probe passes when an editor-site picture is committed. The capture stamp is per base URL, so a Site on production beside a preview base is the owner's call.
